author: Alsybub
quote:
Never pre-order. Never trust critics, they're just paid schills at this point. We live in a world where games are now rated on how much they conform with ideology and politics rather than being enjoyable. As long as the game carries 'the message' and everyone holds the same ideas and beliefs then it gets a good review.

Played every GTA since the PS1 and loved every single one. This is not a GTA game. Such a shame. 

Moral relativism, propaganda and lecturing men are clearly more important than making a good game. RIP GTA and RIP Rockstar.

I feel sorry for the Devs that will inevitably be laid off when the game becomes irrelevant.
